div.head: VI Atr 2.1
div.ab: ⁊ þæt ælces hades men georne gebugan for Gode ⁊ for worolde, ælc to þam rihte þe him to gebyrige,
⁊ þæt ælces hades men georne gebugan for Gode ⁊ for worolde, ælc to þam rihte þe him to gebyrige,
And þæt ælces hades men georne gebugan for Gode and for worolde, ælc to þam rihte þe him to gebyrige.
und dass die Menschen jeglichen Standes, ein jeglicher der Rechtspflicht, die ihm gebührt, sich willig in Geistlichem und Weltlichem unterwerfen,
and that people of every order eagerly submit, each to the duty that belongs to him, in spiritual and in secular matters,
and that men of every estate shall readily submit in matters both religious and secular to the duty which befits them,
And people of every rank shall faithfully submit before God and the world to the duty appropriate for them.
